sides.text: Which device operates at Layer 3 and separates broadcast domains?
A. Router

more.text: Routers forward by IP address and do not forward broadcasts. A Layer 2 switch keeps one broadcast domain per VLAN.

sides.text: A PC has the IP address 169.254.8.4. What most likely happened?
options: It could not reach a DHCP server
DNS failed to resolve a name

sides.text: B. It could not reach a DHCP server

more.text: 169.254.0.0/16 is APIPA, self-assigned when DHCP fails.

sides.text: What is the usable host count of a /27 subnet?
Which address is the broadcast address of 192.168.10.77/26?

more.text: Block size 64: the subnet is .64–.127, broadcast .127.

sides.text: Which statement about TCP and UDP is correct?
options: TCP is connection-oriented and acknowledges data; UDP is connectionless
TCP has lower overhead than UDP

sides.text: A. TCP is connection-oriented and acknowledges data; UDP is connectionless

more.text: TCP adds reliability; UDP is best effort.

sides.text: Which cable type connects two switches when Auto-MDIX is not available?
B. Crossover

more.text: Like devices use crossover; rollover is a console cable.

sides.text: A link shows many late collisions and runts. What is the most likely cause?
C. Duplex mismatch

more.text: Late collisions on a full-duplex-capable link point to a half/full mismatch.

sides.text: Which IPv6 address type begins with FE80?
D. Link-local

more.text: fe80::/10 is link-local.

sides.text: What is the shortest valid form of 2001:0DB8:0000:0000:0000:0000:0000:0001?

more.text: Compress the longest zero run with :: once and drop leading zeros.

sides.text: Which wireless channels are non-overlapping in the 2.4 GHz band in the US?

more.text: Channels are 5 MHz apart but 22 MHz wide.

sides.text: A switch receives a frame whose destination MAC is not in the MAC table. What does it do?
options: Broadcasts it only to the trunk
Sends it to the default gateway
Floods it out all ports except the ingress port

sides.text: C. Floods it out all ports except the ingress port

more.text: Unknown unicast is flooded.

sides.text: Which of these is an RFC 1918 address?
Which hypervisor type runs directly on hardware?
A. Type 1

more.text: ESXi and KVM are Type 1.

sides.text: How many /26 subnets can be created from 10.0.1.0/24?

more.text: Borrowing 2 bits gives 2² = 4.

sides.text: Which address type is used by the IPv6 Neighbor Discovery protocol instead of ARP broadcast?
C. Solicited-node multicast

more.text: IPv6 has no broadcast; NDP uses multicast.

sides.text: What does a 100 Mbps Cat5e cable maximum run length equal?
D. 100 meters

more.text: Ethernet copper segments max at 100 m.

sides.text: Which command shows the IP address, mask, gateway, and DNS servers on a Windows host?
A. ipconfig /all

more.text: ipconfig /all is the Windows command.

sides.text: Two switches use dynamic auto on both ends of a link. What is the result?
B. An access link

more.text: Auto waits for the other side to ask; neither does.

sides.text: Which statement describes a three-tier campus design?
C. Access, distribution, and core layers

more.text: Two-tier collapses distribution and core.

sides.text: Which standard delivers up to 30 W per PoE port?
Which VRF characteristic is true?
options: It keeps separate routing tables on one router

sides.text: A. It keeps separate routing tables on one router

more.text: VRFs isolate routing.

sides.text: What is the network address of 172.16.45.200/20?

more.text: Block size 16 in the third octet: 45 falls in 32–47.

sides.text: Which Ethernet frame field detects transmission errors?
C. FCS

more.text: The frame check sequence is a CRC.

sides.text: A host sends a frame to a MAC address learned on the same port it arrived on. What does the switch do?
D. Filters (drops) the frame

more.text: Source and destination on the same segment: no forwarding needed.

sides.text: Which cloud model gives customers an operating system and runtime but not the application?
A. PaaS

more.text: PaaS provides a platform; IaaS provides infrastructure; SaaS provides software.
